name: AwrAIter REST v1
description: The MCP tool catalog over plain HTTP. One endpoint per tool: read tools answer `GET` with the arguments in the query string (also `POST` with a JSON body), write tools answer `POST` only. The body of every answer is the tool result; the HTTP status is derived from its error code. Authenticate with a personal access token or an OAuth token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; the same token works for `/mcp`. Every non-2xx answer is `{ ok: false, error: { code, message } }`. The version is in the path: a breaking change ships as a new prefix, and this one keeps answering for 12 months after that with `Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers (see `x-deprecation-policy`).
